routes.scope: Fixed narrowed argument subset; bounded double-sampled native task-equivalent observation, not complete native-source/connectivity/persistence proof. Native equivalent for the installed public font-list wrapper, which catches failures as []. Reads only the existing configured font-title list; does not invoke the public getter or its missing-configuration empty fallback. Requires one exact active ordinary schematic, symbol, PCB or footprint context in the main UI host. UI.gVars, current project, native tab, tab data and both active-tab reader receivers are retained. Missing or accessor-backed configuration/array/title fields refuse rather than becoming an empty result. Returns at most 512 configured titles, 1024 UTF-16 code units per title and 131072 combined, preserving order, duplicates, empty strings, whitespace and case without coercion. No font IDs, other preference fields, credentials or complete settings object are returned. Two synchronous complete path/row/title observations per dispatch plus the coordinator's two matching observations and context/runtime checks. Changes away and back between checks cannot be detected; this is not atomic settings isolation. Configured names in the currently loaded UI only, not current-account or persisted-settings identity, OS font installation, glyph coverage or rendering verification. No preference persistence, font add/delete, local storage, filesystem, network, navigation, design serialization or Save. Source tests do not establish connected validation.

routes.scope: EasyEDA 3.2.209/API 0.3.59 only: public File/File comparison of two exact managed ASCII Allegro .tel artifacts. Local prepare-file writes supplied text to an exclusive managed artifact without app access. Complete subset recognition and an independent model require every returned footprint-to-designator and net-to-pin difference to agree. Two bounded samples retain their original UI, method, RPC and File owners with a monotonic deadline. Values, properties and circuit correctness are not compared; empty differences establish membership equality only. Document UUID/object overloads, .enet and other formats remain omitted: the UUID path dispatches a project-worker read, .enet can retrieve project library assets, and the object overload has no matching implementation. No arbitrary path, export, navigation, upload, CAD edit or Save. Offline exact-source parser fixtures and runtime regressions are not installed connected validation.

routes.scope: Separately reviewed EasyEDA 3.2.209/API 0.3.59 only; older profiles do not register this route. Single requests or a batch of up to seven unique methods use two matching observations. Batch methods share one ten-second deadline and retain all owners before invocation; two ordered passes are sequential, not atomic. Each member is bounded to 8192 bytes and the complete batch to 65536 bytes. One failed member refuses the whole result; no cached authority or partial success. Only the separately hash-admitted EasyEDA 3.2.209 / API 0.3.59 tuple. No admission of older, newer or unknown implementations, native adapters or general SDK dispatch. Two complete samples retain the same extension, namespace and method. Viewport reads retain the window object. UI-backed methods additionally require exact UI and selector files and retain the editor window, document, UI, host and method-specific available RPC bus around each await. No project, document, account, file, network, navigation, settings change or Save access is performed by these getters. Replies are bounded to 8192 UTF-8 bytes. Synchronous methods reject Promises; UI-backed methods await sequentially. Partial or malformed values, changed owners, unstable samples and oversized responses refuse without truncation or automatic retry. Source implementation and synthetic tests do not establish connected validation. UI-backed reads enforce a 10-second monotonic deadline around every await and before a second sample. The timer is cooperative; it does not cancel an outstanding vendor RPC or synchronous vendor work. The 60-second execution and 70-second transport limits are separate waiting bounds. This SDK method is beta. It awaits the global toolbar selection and accepts only mm, inch or mil. The reviewed handler maps unit(mm), unit(inch) and unit(mil) from an existing UI store; it does not resolve a document. This value may reflect the default or a previous selection and never establishes schematic coordinate scale, PCB native units or an active document's settings. Missing or other values refuse.
Fixed complete argument subset; bounded double-sampled public SDK observation, not complete native-source/connectivity/persistence proof.
